retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast surreal composition featuring a glowing blue celestial body held by a human hand against a saturated magenta and red textured background.
triggerTerms: saturated color field with celestial object

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, highly detailed blue moon with visible craters is held from below by a human hand. The background is a textured, painterly gradient of hot pink and red, framed on the right by a vertical rainbow spectrum bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the electric blue moon and the magenta background
Scale distortion where a celestial body is small enough to be held by a hand
Vertical color spectrum bar acting as a structural frame on the right edge
Textured, cloud-like background providing organic depth to the flat color field
coreInvariants: The moon must be a saturated electric blue with visible lunar topography
The background must utilize a high-saturation magenta-to-red gradient
A human hand must enter from the bottom left to support the sphere

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The blue moon is the central focal point, occupying approximately 50% of the vertical space. The hand enters from the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing blue moon serves as the primary anchor, stabilized by the hand below it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright blue moon, follows the hand downward, and then moves to the vertical rainbow strip on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured magenta background provides significant negative space, emphasizing the central subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all elements with high value contrast between the glowing moon and the darker hand.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all metadata to maintain a utilitarian, industrial look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the metadata text.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-saturation magenta and red textured background with a vertical rainbow gradient strip on the far right edge. Place a detailed electric blue moon in the center, held by a human hand entering from the bottom left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, white, condensed sans-serif text in the top-left corner, stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant magenta/red gradient?
Is there a rainbow strip on the right edge?
Is the text in the top-left corner white and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Moon color (e.g., neon green or yellow)
mustRedesign: Do not use specific brand logos
Do not use specific artist names
Ensure the hand is a generic representation

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the moon's craters
avoid: Overlapping text on the main subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleeding between the moon and background
Ensure the rainbow strip is perfectly vertical
Confirm the text is aligned to the top-left margin
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central glowing celestial sphere with a high-contrast textured color field and a geometric framing element on one edge.
